question: How do I add a friend?
answer: Open the Friends tab in Bubble and click the 'Add Friend' button. Enter their username or scan their Bubble QR code.

question: How do I change password?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Change Password in your Bubble app settings to update your password.

question: Why am I not receiving notifications?
answer: Please check your system-level notification permissions for Bubble. Go to Settings > Notifications on your device, and ensure notifications are enabled.

question: What is Bubble?
answer: Bubble is a modern, real-time messaging and chatting application designed to help you stay connected with friends, family, and colleagues instantly and securely.

question: How do I start a new chat?
answer: To start a new chat, tap the chat bubble icon or 'New Chat' button on the Chats screen, select a contact from your friend list, and start typing your message.

question: Can I send photos, videos, or documents?
answer: Yes! In any Bubble chat, tap the paperclip (+) icon next to the message input box. You can attach photos, videos, voice recordings, and various document files.

question: How do I create a group chat?
answer: Go to the Chats tab, click on the options menu (three dots or new chat icon), select 'New Group', add the members you want to include, set a group name/photo, and tap create.

question: Is my data secure on Bubble?
answer: Security is our priority at Bubble. We use industry-standard encryption protocols to protect your chats, media, and profile information from unauthorized access.

question: How do I block or unblock someone?
answer: To block a user, open their profile or chat settings, scroll down, and select 'Block'. To unblock someone, go to Settings > Privacy > Blocked Contacts, and tap 'Unblock' next to their name.

question: Can I use Bubble on multiple devices?
answer: Yes, Bubble supports multi-device synchronization. You can log into your account on web or desktop app versions, and your chats will sync in real-time.

question: Is Bubble free to use?
answer: Yes, Bubble is completely free to download and use for standard text messaging, voice calls, and video calls. Standard cellular data charges may apply depending on your network provider.
